setting: One locked-off wide Minecraft-style voxel shot from a cherry blossom tea house veranda beside a pond. Open eaves frame the garden; no humans.
pet: a small dog asleep on a cushion under the eaves, with its ears and tail visible
signature: cherry petals drift from the overhanging tree and settle on the rain-dimpled pond
signature_detail: a tiny gecko crawls along the flat stone pond ledge at the lower right, then peeks into a square notch
stages: low tea table with a cup
foreground: dry veranda floorboards, the sleeping dog, and a low tea table
midground: the pond ledge and open water beneath flowering branches
background: a rain-softened garden path and distant blocky bamboo
light: soft overcast morning light with a warm lantern glow under the eaves
title_idea: Rainy Morning at Blossom Veranda | 10 Hours of Minecraft Ambience
intro_lines: Welcome to the Blossom Veranda, come sit with me and listen to the rain

pick_scores.note: Calm, layered veranda view with a clear pond and overhanging blossoms. Dog, cup, and lantern are distinct, but no cup steam is visible; cushions are not indigo.
Strong foreground-to-garden depth. The sleeping dog and hanging lantern are easy to isolate for animation, though the cup is small and has no visible steam.
Pond and drifting petals read well, but the large foreground light competes with the scene and the cup is pushed to the edge. No visible steam or indigo cushions.
Best-balanced locked-off view: dog, cup, lantern, overhanging blossoms, and pond are clearly separated. Steam is not visible and the cushions are not indigo.
